en.title: Currency Trading Strategy
en.description:
Strategy values are limited to −1 (sell), 0 (hold), and +1 (buy), and the profit on day i is −strategy[i]×rate[i]. Choose exactly one contiguous window of length k and reset the strategies in that window to one of these three valid values; find the maximum total profit. Interpreting any value as any value in the set of strategy values is an explicit type convention of this site.

The problem semantics follow the fixed OAMaster snapshot; the input protocol and limits supplemented by this site are defined by this site.
en.input: n,k (1≤k≤n≤200000), rates in 0..10⁹, and strategy in −1/0/+1. The ranges are site supplements.
en.explanation: See the accompanying editorial for the full approach, proof, and complexity.
